title.zh: Qwen-Image-2.1: Compact, efficient, and unified image creation
title.en: Qwen-Image-2.1: Compact, efficient, and unified image creation

current_state.zh: Qwen released Qwen-Image-2.1, a compact 7B open-weight image generation model with native transparency and markedly improved text rendering, though under a more restrictive license than earlier Qwen releases.
